set: 4 SWOW (ES/EN/ZH/NL) + 3 taxonomy (WordNet EN, BabelNet RU/AR); ConceptNet removed

kw_family.conclusion: no significant effect of language family on mean curvature (p>0.05)
kw_family.caveat: network-level KW; group sizes 5/1/1 -> very low power. Original manuscript H=1.83 not exactly reproducible (this method gives H=2.08 on the 8-graph set); the qualitative 'no family effect' holds but the statistic is fragile at this N.

kw_category.note: Association vs Taxonomy is the structurally meaningful contrast; reported as the robust alternative.

gam.caveat: N=7 data points -> the smooth is descriptive, not inferential; treat the sweet-spot bounds as indicative. Weighted-C sweet spot is NARROWER than the manuscript's [0.023,0.147] (likely a different C scale / ConceptNet-extended lower bound).
gam.vs_manuscript: Manuscript reported R2_adj=0.78 + sweet spot C in [0.023,0.147] on the 8-graph set. On 7 graphs (ConceptNet removed, weighted C) the fit WEAKENS to explained_deviance ~0.79 and is unstable (range 0.18-0.68 across lam). Removing ConceptNet (which sat at C=0.014-0.017 and filled the valley's lower wall) is the main cause. The clean [0.023,0.147] does NOT reproduce.
gam.interpretation: explained_deviance=0.795 is reached ONLY at the gridsearch best_lam=0.026 (near-interpolation of 7 points = overfitting). With meaningful smoothing (lam 0.1-30) it falls to 0.18-0.68. At N=7 the '0.78' is not a robust fit — it is an overfitting artifact. Sweet-spot upper bound 0.147 does NOT reproduce (no network has weighted C>0.046).

sigma_k_secondary_moderator.reason: The manuscript's sigma_k interaction (p=0.004) was driven largely by ConceptNet (sigma_k 5.6-7.3). Without it, the 4 SWOW have sigma_k 1.7-2.6 while taxonomies are 2.6-4.1 (HIGHER) — the 'elevated sigma_k drives hyperbolicity' direction does not hold in the 7-graph set. An interaction test at N=7 is not defensible; this claim should be dropped or re-examined, not re-fit.
